steps.content: Your long journey finally reaches the end.
You've found a gap amid the horde of monsters and break through the encirclement with the modified high-speed mech, shaking off those monsters. The temporal storm is right ahead of you.
The journey of crossing the temporal storm, for some reason, feels so long.
You two gallop across the wasteland, relentlessly marching forward... You journey across boundless time, from the past to the future, as everything rapidly falls away behind you two.
Even time can't catch up with you. The future is right ahead.
You're suddenly attacked by something. The violent jolts almost topple you over. It seems something has pierced the mech.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: No way... What could catch up with my...
You look up to see a huge shadow above the mech.
The surface of the object above you is so decayed that you can't see its color; it's full of rust and scars... and standing atop it is a dark and ominous figure.

The monsters that appear multiple times in the same spacetime, the never-ending supplies... Now it finally makes sense to you. The ominous storm distorts spacetime, and this is where the past and future intersect.
You finally recognize the figure in front of you.
What you see subverts everything you know. Stunned, you turn your head in disbelief to look at the person beside you.
They look the same and pilot the same mech. But now, the Vanilla beside you is turning blurry.
The shadow completely covers the mech, the despairing future swallows the past.
Both of the mechs and pilots gradually overlap, merging into one.
